name: Tro'Har
description: Tro'Har was a planet located within the Coyn system of the Outer Rim Territories in the Elrood sector. Covered in methane ice, it boasted a navigation beacon to assist inbound traffic. The name "Tro'Har" meant "Farthest Blade" in the Coynite language.
